worldcombat.skill.cut.summary: Drop low and push out one skimming cut: every foe in the fan in front of you takes contact damage, and the grass, flowers and leaves inside the arc are cut away as you pass. It is the family's fastest, cheapest and widest slash - the wide form reaches further and clears more, the heavy form is narrower but bites harder.
worldcombat.skill.cut.description.0: The skimming cut deals one hit of about %1$s contact damage to every foe inside the arc.
worldcombat.skill.cut.description.1: It reaches %1$s blocks with a %2$s degree opening, covering %3$s blocks above the feet.
worldcombat.skill.cut.description.2: It cuts up to %1$s low plants inside the arc.
worldcombat.skill.cut.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.cut.growth.0: From level %1$s the reach extends to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.cut.growth.1: From level %1$s the cut rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.cut.use.0: Sweep a whole arc with a skimming cut
worldcombat.skill.cut.use.1: Cut the grass away as you pass
worldcombat.skill.cut.preference.wide.he: On (skimming cut): a wider opening, a slightly taller band and more plants cut, at 86% per-hit power and a longer cooldown. Off (heavy cleave): 118% power and a faster recovery, at the cost of a narrower arc and far fewer plants.
worldcombat.skill.cut.preference.ai.maxC: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of sweeping. Larger values open the sweep from further out.
worldcombat.skill.cut.preference.ai.clus: On: with two or more enemies in range it sweeps first, treating the move as a clear-out. Off: it ranks the move as an ordinary cheap attack whatever the numbers.
